words.enDefinition: the process of signing up for next term's courses

examples.en: Course registration opens at seven on Monday morning, so set your alarm.
examples.zh: 「选课注册」周一早上七点开放，记得定好闹钟。

examples.en: My course registration failed twice because the portal crashed right at seven.
examples.zh: 系统七点整崩了，我的「选课注册」失败了两次。

words.enDefinition: officially sign up for your courses before the term starts

examples.en: Freshmen register for classes right after they meet their advisors.
examples.zh: 大一新生见完导师后就「注册选课」。

examples.en: I couldn't register for classes until I cleared the library hold.
examples.zh: 解除图书馆的欠书冻结后，我才能「注册选课」。

words.enDefinition: officially add yourself to a course's student list

examples.en: You can't enroll in a course without meeting its prerequisites first.
examples.zh: 不满足先修要求，你就没法「选修」这门课。

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a course outside her major for fun.
examples.zh: 她决定「选修」一门专业外的课，纯属兴趣。

words.enDefinition: your assigned time slot to begin registering online

examples.en: My enrollment appointment is Tuesday at two, way later than my roommate's.
examples.zh: 我的「选课预约时段」在周二下午两点，比室友晚多了。

examples.en: Check when your enrollment appointment starts so you don't miss it.
examples.zh: 查好你的「选课预约时段」从什么时候开始，别错过了。

words.enDefinition: assigned registration start time issued by some universities

examples.en: My time ticket says I can register Thursday at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 我的「选课时间票」显示周四九点整可以开始选课。

examples.en: Students with more credits get an earlier time ticket for registration.
examples.zh: 学分多的学生能拿到更早的「选课时间票」。

words.enDefinition: official window when students may sign up for courses

examples.en: The registration period for spring courses starts in early November.
examples.zh: 春季课程的「选课期」十一月初开始。

examples.en: Don't panic if you miss the first registration period; there's a second round.
examples.zh: 错过第一轮「选课期」也别慌，还有第二轮呢。

words.enDefinition: signing up for courses before the general registration window

examples.en: Honors students get early registration, which helps them grab popular sections.
examples.zh: 荣誉项目学生享有「提前注册」，方便抢到热门课段。

examples.en: Use your early registration slot to lock in the lab section you need.
examples.zh: 抓住「提前注册」的机会，锁定你需要的实验课段。

words.enDefinition: registering after the official period, often with a fee

examples.en: I missed the deadline and had to pay a late registration fee.
examples.zh: 我错过了截止日期，只好交「逾期注册」费。

examples.en: Late registration runs through the first week with department approval.
examples.zh: 经系里批准，「逾期注册」可持续到开学第一周。

words.enDefinition: earlier enrollment slots given to certain student groups

examples.en: Student athletes and honors students usually qualify for priority registration.
examples.zh: 体育特长生和荣誉项目学生通常可以「优先选课」。

examples.en: Apply for priority registration if you're a veteran or a student parent.
examples.zh: 如果你是退伍军人或学生家长，可以申请「优先选课」。

words.enDefinition: first weeks when you can freely add or drop courses

examples.en: Use the add/drop period to test whether a course really suits you.
examples.zh: 善用「退补选期」，看看这门课到底适不适合你。

examples.en: Switching sections is painless during the add/drop period, so don't stress.
examples.zh: 「退补选期」内换课段毫无压力，别太焦虑。

collocations: take advantage of the add/drop period

words.enDefinition: last day to add or drop without a record

examples.en: The add/drop deadline is Friday, so finalize your schedule tonight.
examples.zh: 「退补选截止日」是周五，今晚就把课表定下来吧。

examples.en: After the add/drop deadline, dropping shows a W on your transcript.
examples.zh: 过了「退补选截止日」，退课会在成绩单上记一个 W。

words.enDefinition: final date to enroll in courses for a term

examples.en: The enrollment deadline for winter courses is the third of December.
examples.zh: 冬季课程的「选课截止日」是十二月三日。

examples.en: Email your advisor before the enrollment deadline if a course is full.
examples.zh: 如果某门课满了，要在「选课截止日」前邮件联系导师。

words.enDefinition: official dates for terms, breaks, and registration deadlines

examples.en: Check the academic calendar before you book flights home for winter break.
examples.zh: 订寒假回家的机票前，先查一下「校历」。

examples.en: The academic calendar lists every add/drop deadline and exam period.
examples.zh: 「校历」上列出了每个退补选截止日和考试周。

words.enDefinition: schedule dividing the academic year into four short terms

examples.en: Under the quarter system, courses move fast and finals come quickly.
examples.zh: 「学季制」下课程节奏很快，期末也来得早。

examples.en: Transferring from a quarter system school means converting your credits.
examples.zh: 从「学季制」学校转过来，学分还需要换算。

words.enDefinition: your year level, like freshman or junior, for registration

examples.en: Your class standing decides when you can register for popular courses.
examples.zh: 你的「年级」决定了你什么时候能注册热门课程。

examples.en: Transfer credits can bump your class standing to sophomore overnight.
examples.zh: 转学分能让你的「年级资格」一夜之间升到大二。

words.enDefinition: whether you are currently registered, full-time, or withdrawn

examples.en: Your enrollment status must stay full-time to keep your visa valid.
examples.zh: 「注册状态」必须保持全日制，签证才有效。

examples.en: The registrar updated my enrollment status after I dropped a course.
examples.zh: 我退了一门课后，注册办公室更新了我的「注册状态」。

words.enDefinition: short summer term for catching up on credits

examples.en: Taking statistics during summer session leaves my fall schedule lighter.
examples.zh: 「夏季学期」先修统计，秋季课表就轻松些。

examples.en: Summer session classes are condensed, so expect assignments due almost daily.
examples.zh: 「夏季学期」课程很紧凑，几乎每天都要交作业。

words.enDefinition: formal enrollment as a degree-seeking student

examples.en: Matriculation happens online now, so no more queueing at the registrar's office.
examples.zh: 现在「入学注册」都在网上完成，不用去注册办公室排队了。

examples.en: Bring photo ID to finish your matriculation during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周办理「入学注册」时，记得携带带照片的证件。

words.enDefinition: early course sign-up before official registration opens

examples.en: Submit your pre-registration form so the department can plan sections.
examples.zh: 提交「预选课」表，系里才能规划课段。

examples.en: Pre-registration doesn't guarantee a seat, but it gives you priority.
examples.zh: 「预注册」不保证有位置，但能给你优先权。

words.enDefinition: officially sign up for an extra course

examples.en: You can still add a course until Friday through the portal.
examples.zh: 周五之前你仍然可以在系统里「加选」一门课。

examples.en: The instructor signed my form so I could add a course late.
examples.zh: 老师在我的表格上签了字，我才能逾期「加选」这门课。

collocations: add a course after the deadline

words.enDefinition: officially remove a course from your schedule

examples.en: Think twice before you drop a course after the first exam.
examples.zh: 第一次考试后再想「退课」，务必三思。

examples.en: I dropped one course to protect my GPA during a rough semester.
examples.zh: 那学期太难熬了，我「退掉」一门课来保住绩点。

collocations: drop a course before the deadline

words.enDefinition: drop one course while adding another in one step

examples.en: You can swap a course in one step without losing your other seats.
examples.zh: 「换课」一步到位，不会丢掉其他课的名额。

examples.en: I decided to swap a course so my job shifts wouldn't clash with labs.
examples.zh: 我决定「换课」，这样上班时间就不会和实验课冲突了。

words.enDefinition: move to a different meeting time of the same course

examples.en: You can change sections online if seats open in another group.
examples.zh: 如果另一组有空位，你可以在网上「更换课段」。

examples.en: I want to change sections because Thursday labs clash with my shift.
examples.zh: 我想「更换课段」，周四的实验课和我的班次冲突了。

words.enDefinition: attend a course regularly without earning credit

examples.en: You can audit a course for free if the instructor agrees.
examples.zh: 只要任课老师同意，你就能免费「旁听」这门课。

examples.en: Some seniors audit a course they loved one last time before graduating.
examples.zh: 有些大四学生会毕业前再「旁听」一次自己喜欢的课。

words.enDefinition: take a course again to improve the grade

examples.en: You must repeat a course if you failed a required one.
examples.zh: 必修课挂科了就必须「重修」这门课。

examples.en: Ask your advisor whether it's better to repeat a course or take an elective.
examples.zh: 问问导师是「重修」这门课好，还是改选别的课好。

collocations: repeat a course for a better grade

words.enDefinition: try to get into a full course by asking directly

examples.en: You can crash a course by emailing the professor, even if it shows full.
examples.zh: 即使系统显示满员，发邮件给教授也可能「挤进满员的课」。

examples.en: First-years crash a course when nothing else fits their schedule.
examples.zh: 实在没有合适的课时，大一新生就会试着「挤课」。

collocations: crash a course during the first week

words.enDefinition: officially choose your main field of study

examples.en: Most students declare a major by the end of sophomore year.
examples.zh: 大多数学生会在大二结束前「确定专业」。

examples.en: You can't register for advanced courses until you declare a major.
examples.zh: 在「确定专业」之前，你不能注册进阶课程。

collocations: declare a major before junior year

words.enDefinition: dropping a course after the deadline, with a W grade

examples.en: A course withdrawal after midterms still shows a W on your record.
examples.zh: 期中之后「退课」，成绩单上仍会记一个 W。

examples.en: Talk to financial aid before a course withdrawal; it may affect your aid.
examples.zh: 「退课」前先问问资助办公室，可能会影响你的资助资格。

words.enDefinition: last day to withdraw with a W instead of a grade

examples.en: The withdrawal deadline this term is the Friday of week nine.
examples.zh: 本学期的「退课截止日」是第九周的周五。

examples.en: After the withdrawal deadline, you'll receive a real letter grade.
examples.zh: 过了「退课截止日」，就会拿到正式的课程评分。

words.enDefinition: removal from a course by the university, not the student

examples.en: I got an administrative drop for missing the first two labs.
examples.zh: 因为缺了前两次实验课，我被「强制退课」了。

examples.en: Administrative drops free up seats during the first week of term.
examples.zh: 开学第一周，「行政退课」会腾出一些名额。

words.enDefinition: Holding some places in a class for students who meet specified enrollment criteria.

examples.en: The registrar explained that reserved seating keeps some places available for students in the program.
examples.zh: 教务处解释，「预留选课名额」是为该项目的学生保留部分课位。

examples.en: Check the notes on reserved seating before you add the lab to your schedule.
examples.zh: 把实验课加入课表之前，先看「预留选课名额」的说明。

words.enDefinition: permission code needed to join a closed course

examples.en: Email the professor for an add code if the section is full.
examples.zh: 如果课段满员，发邮件向教授要「加选码」。

examples.en: Enter the add code in the portal and the course opens instantly.
examples.zh: 在系统里输入「加选码」，课程立刻就能加上。

words.enDefinition: code from a department that lets you bypass restrictions

examples.en: The department emailed me a permission number for the capped seminar.
examples.zh: 系里给我发了一个「选课许可号」，用于选限额研讨课。

examples.en: Without a permission number, the portal blocks any restricted course.
examples.zh: 没有「选课许可号」，系统会挡下所有受限课程。

words.enDefinition: approval from the professor to join a course

examples.en: The catalog lists instructor permission as the only requirement to enroll.
examples.zh: 课程目录显示，「教师许可」是选这门课的唯一要求。

examples.en: Get instructor permission before you try adding the advanced seminar.
examples.zh: 想加选这门进阶研讨课，先拿到「教师许可」。

words.enDefinition: consent from the academic department to enroll

examples.en: Cross-listed courses sometimes require department approval before you can enroll.
examples.zh: 跨系并列的课有时需要「系里批准」才能选。

examples.en: She got department approval to take a graduate seminar as a junior.
examples.zh: 她获得「系里批准」，大三就能修研究生研讨课。

words.enDefinition: unit measuring course weight, usually one hour weekly

examples.en: Most lecture courses are worth three credit hours each semester.
examples.zh: 大多数讲授课每学期值三个「学分学时」。

examples.en: Lab science courses often carry four credit hours because of labs.
examples.zh: 理科实验课常因包含实验而值四个「学分学时」。

words.enDefinition: total credits you take in a single term

examples.en: Keep your credit load balanced so assignments don't pile up.
examples.zh: 「学分量」要安排均衡，作业才不会堆积如山。

examples.en: Her credit load jumped to eighteen credits after adding two labs.
examples.zh: 加了两门实验课后，她的「学分量」升到了十八个学分。

words.enDefinition: number and difficulty of courses you take at once

examples.en: A heavy course load plus a part-time job is exhausting.
examples.zh: 「课业负担」重还要打工，实在让人疲惫。

examples.en: Your advisor can help you plan a manageable course load each term.
examples.zh: 导师能帮你规划每学期适度的「课程负担」。

words.enDefinition: standard maximum credits expected of a full-time student

examples.en: International students must maintain a full course load to stay compliant.
examples.zh: 国际学生必须保持「满额课程负担」才符合规定。

examples.en: A full course load here means fifteen credits each semester.
examples.zh: 这里的「满额课程负担」指每学期十五个学分。

words.enDefinition: approved enrollment below full-time, often for visa reasons

examples.en: With dean's approval, a reduced course load won't violate your visa status.
examples.zh: 经院长批准，「减量选课」不会违反你的签证身份。

examples.en: She requested a reduced course load during her medical recovery.
examples.zh: 身体恢复期间，她申请了「减量选课」。

collocations: reduced course load for medical reasons

words.enDefinition: maximum credits you may take in one term

examples.en: The credit cap is eighteen, but honors students can exceed it.
examples.zh: 「学分上限」是十八，但荣誉项目学生可以超出。

examples.en: Petition to lift the credit cap if you're ahead on requirements.
examples.zh: 如果你学分超前，可以申请提高「学分上限」。

words.enDefinition: taking more credits than the standard limit allows

examples.en: A credit overload requires dean approval and a consistently strong GPA.
examples.zh: 「超修学分」需要院长批准，而且绩点要一直很高。

examples.en: She took a credit overload to finish her double major on time.
examples.zh: 为了按时完成双专业，她「超修」了学分。

words.enDefinition: course you must complete for your degree

examples.en: Calculus is a required course for every engineering freshman here.
examples.zh: 微积分是这里所有工科大一新生的「必修课」。

examples.en: Check the catalog so no required course slips through your plan.
examples.zh: 查好课程目录，别让任何「必修课」漏出你的计划。

words.enDefinition: course you choose freely beyond your requirements

examples.en: Film appreciation is easily my favorite elective course this semester.
examples.zh: 电影赏析轻松当选我这学期最爱的「选修课」。

examples.en: Use elective courses to explore interesting fields outside your major.
examples.zh: 借助「选修课」探索专业以外的领域。

words.enDefinition: central required course within your major

examples.en: Organic chemistry is a core course for all pre-med students.
examples.zh: 有机化学是所有医学预科生的「核心课程」。

examples.en: Register early because core courses fill up the fastest each term.
examples.zh: 尽早注册，「核心课程」每学期都最先满员。

words.enDefinition: courses outside your major that everyone must complete

examples.en: The writing seminar satisfies a general education requirement for freshmen.
examples.zh: 这门写作研讨课满足大一新生的「通识教育要求」。

examples.en: Knock out your general education requirements early with summer courses.
examples.zh: 尽早利用暑期课程修完「通识要求」。

words.enDefinition: credits and courses needed to graduate

examples.en: The degree audit shows which degree requirements you still need.
examples.zh: 学位审核会显示你还差哪些「学位要求」。

examples.en: Meet with your advisor yearly to review degree requirement progress.
examples.zh: 每年和导师复盘一次「学位要求」的完成进度。

words.enDefinition: fixed set of courses all students complete

examples.en: Their core curriculum includes philosophy, academic writing, and quantitative reasoning.
examples.zh: 他们的「核心课程体系」包括哲学、学术写作和定量推理。

examples.en: Transfer credits sometimes count toward parts of the core curriculum.
examples.zh: 转学分有时能抵充「核心课程体系」的部分内容。

words.enDefinition: course you must finish before taking another

examples.en: Organic chemistry lists general chemistry I as a hard prerequisite.
examples.zh: 有机化学把「普通化学 I」列为严格的先修课程。

examples.en: The portal blocks enrollment automatically if you're missing a prerequisite.
examples.zh: 缺少「先修课程」时，系统会自动禁止选课。

words.enDefinition: course you must take at the same time as another

examples.en: The lab is a corequisite, so register for both CRNs together.
examples.zh: 实验课是「同修课程」，两个课程号要一起注册。

examples.en: You can't enroll in the lecture without adding its corequisite.
examples.zh: 不加选「同修课程」，你就选不了这门大课。

words.enDefinition: official permission to skip a required prior course

examples.en: My AP score earned me a prerequisite waiver for calculus.
examples.zh: 我的 AP 成绩帮我拿到了微积分的「先修豁免」。

examples.en: Ask the department for a prerequisite waiver if you have equivalent experience.
examples.zh: 如果你有同等学习经历，可以向系里申请「先修豁免」。

words.enDefinition: outline of topics, grading, and deadlines for one course

examples.en: Read the course syllabus carefully before the add/drop deadline hits.
examples.zh: 在退补选截止日之前，仔细读一遍「课程大纲」。

examples.en: The course syllabus shows the grading breakdown and exam dates.
examples.zh: 「课程大纲」列明了评分构成和考试日期。

words.enDefinition: short summary of what a course covers

examples.en: The course description mentions a weekly lab, so plan your schedule.
examples.zh: 「课程简介」提到每周有实验课，排课表时要留意。

examples.en: Read the course descriptions carefully before enrolling, not just the catchy titles.
examples.zh: 选课前认真读「课程简介」，别只看吸引人的课名。

words.enDefinition: official listing of every course a school offers

examples.en: Search the course catalog for classes that fit your work schedule.
examples.zh: 在「课程目录」里搜索符合你作息的课。

examples.en: The course catalog lists prerequisites, credits, and which terms each class runs.
examples.zh: 「课程目录」列出先修要求、学分以及各课的开课学期。

words.enDefinition: letters and numbers identifying a course, like MATH 101

examples.en: Enter the exact course code, or the portal won't find it.
examples.zh: 输入准确的「课程代码」，否则系统找不到。

examples.en: The same course code appears on your transcript after you finish.
examples.zh: 修完之后，同一个「课程代码」会出现在你的成绩单上。

words.enDefinition: official name of a course in the catalog

examples.en: The course title sounds fun, but check the workload first.
examples.zh: 这个「课程名称」听起来有趣，但先看看课业量。

examples.en: Course titles occasionally change when departments redesign their major requirements.
examples.zh: 系里调整培养要求时，「课程名称」偶尔会变。

words.enDefinition: class taken for learning without earning credits

examples.en: The writing center offers a free non-credit course for internationals.
examples.zh: 写作中心为国际学生开设了免费的「非学分课程」。

examples.en: A non-credit course won't affect your GPA or credit load.
examples.zh: 「非学分课程」不影响你的绩点和学分量。

words.enDefinition: basic first course in a subject area

examples.en: Take the introductory course before jumping into any advanced seminars.
examples.zh: 先修「入门课程」，再去选高级研讨课。

examples.en: Introductory courses are huge, so discussion sections fill within minutes.
examples.zh: 「入门课程」人数众多，讨论课段几分钟就被抢光。

words.enDefinition: advanced course usually taken by juniors and seniors

examples.en: Most upper-level courses require special instructor permission for sophomore students.
examples.zh: 大多数「高年级课程」要求大二学生先取得教师许可。

examples.en: Save some upper-level courses for senior year when you know your focus.
examples.zh: 留几门「高年级课程」到大四，那时你更清楚方向。

words.enDefinition: one-time course on a current or niche subject

examples.en: This semester's special topics course covers AI ethics and society.
examples.zh: 本学期的「专题课程」讲 AI 伦理与社会。

examples.en: Special topics courses change every term, so grab them while offered.
examples.zh: 「专题课程」每学期都不同，开设时要抓紧选。

words.enDefinition: grading choice earning credit without a letter grade

examples.en: Take that hard philosophy course under the pass/fail option instead.
examples.zh: 那门很难的哲学课，改用「合格/不合格制」修吧。

examples.en: The pass/fail option deadline usually falls around midsemester, so decide early.
examples.zh: 「合格/不合格制」的截止时间通常在期中前后，要尽早决定。

words.enDefinition: choice between letter grades and pass/fail credit

examples.en: You can switch your grading option in the portal until week eight.
examples.zh: 第八周之前，你可以在系统里更改「评分方式」。

examples.en: Some courses don't offer a pass/fail grading option at all.
examples.zh: 有些课程完全不提供「合格/不合格」这种评分方式。

words.enDefinition: self-directed course arranged with one professor

examples.en: Arrange an independent study with Professor Lee on migration policy.
examples.zh: 和李教授安排一门关于移民政策的「独立研究」。

examples.en: Independent study credits usually require a short proposal and department approval.
examples.zh: 「独立研究」学分通常需要一份简短计划书和系里批准。

words.enDefinition: credits earned through an approved internship

examples.en: You can earn internship credit while working at the city council.
examples.zh: 在市议会实习的同时，你还能修「实习学分」。

examples.en: Register for internship credit before the term starts, not after.
examples.zh: 「实习学分」要在开学前注册，不能事后补。

words.enDefinition: supervised practical course connected to fieldwork

examples.en: The counseling practicum places you in a real school for ten hours weekly.
examples.zh: 咨询「实践课」安排你每周到真实学校实习十小时。

examples.en: Register for the practicum early because each site takes few students.
examples.zh: 「实践课」要尽早注册，每个实习点只收少量学生。

words.enDefinition: credits accepted from another college or exam scores

examples.en: My AP scores gave me transfer credit for two intro courses.
examples.zh: 我的 AP 成绩换到了两门入门课的「转学分」。

examples.en: Transfer credits count toward your degree but not your GPA.
examples.zh: 「转学分」计入学位，但不计入绩点。

words.enDefinition: credits earned abroad that count at your home university

examples.en: Get your exchange credit pre-approved before you leave for Tokyo.
examples.zh: 去东京交换之前，先把「交换学分」预批好。

examples.en: Exchange credits from partner universities usually transfer back without issues.
examples.zh: 伙伴院校的「交换学分」通常能顺利转回本校。

words.enDefinition: official review deciding how transfer credits apply

examples.en: The credit evaluation took three weeks after my transcripts arrived.
examples.zh: 成绩单寄到之后，「学分认定」花了三周。

examples.en: Request an official credit evaluation before registering for any overlapping courses.
examples.zh: 注册任何内容重复的课程前，先申请官方「学分认定」。

words.enDefinition: judgment that a course elsewhere matches a local one

examples.en: The registrar granted course equivalency for my statistics class from Sydney.
examples.zh: 注册办公室认定我在悉尼修的统计课与本校课程「等效」。

examples.en: Check the equivalency database before appealing a course equivalency decision.
examples.zh: 申诉「课程等效认定」结果前，先查一下等效课程数据库。

words.enDefinition: college credit earned through Advanced Placement exams

examples.en: My AP credit let me skip introductory biology completely in first year.
examples.zh: 凭「AP学分」，我大一直接免修了入门生物课。

examples.en: Send your official AP scores to receive AP credit on your record.
examples.zh: 寄送官方 AP 成绩，「AP学分」才会记入你的档案。

words.enDefinition: exam deciding which course level you start at

examples.en: Take the online math placement test before your advising appointment.
examples.zh: 在导师面谈之前，先完成在线「数学分级测试」。

examples.en: Language placement tests decide whether you start at intermediate level.
examples.zh: 语言「分级测试」决定你是从中级还是初级学起。

words.enDefinition: secondary field requiring fewer courses than a major

examples.en: Adding an academic minor in statistics strengthened her job applications.
examples.zh: 加修统计「辅修专业」让她的求职简历更有竞争力。

examples.en: Declare an academic minor alongside your major before junior year.
examples.zh: 大三之前，在主修之外「申报辅修专业」。

words.enDefinition: completing two majors at the same time

examples.en: A double major in economics and math takes careful planning.
examples.zh: 经济与数学「双专业」需要细致的规划。

examples.en: Her double major means summer courses to fit every requirement.
examples.zh: 修「双专业」意味着她得靠暑期课程满足所有要求。

words.enDefinition: official switch from one major field to another

examples.en: File your change of major form before spring registration opens.
examples.zh: 春季选课开放前，先提交「转专业」申请表。

examples.en: Her change of major meant three new required courses next term.
examples.zh: 这次「转专业」意味着下学期要多修三门新必修课。

words.enDefinition: approved swap of one required course for another

examples.en: The department approved a course substitution for my overseas statistics class.
examples.zh: 系里批准我用国外修的统计课做「课程替代」。

examples.en: File the course substitution form before your final semester begins.
examples.zh: 最后一学期开始前，提交「课程替代」申请表。

words.enDefinition: one scheduled group meeting of a course

examples.en: Section 002 of the lecture meets Tuesdays and Thursdays at ten.
examples.zh: 这门大课的「002课段」在周二和周四上午十点上课。

examples.en: Pick a section whose discussion times don't clash with labs.
examples.zh: 选一个讨论时间不与实验课冲突的「课段」。

words.enDefinition: digits identifying which meeting group you join

examples.en: Registration asks for the CRN, not just the section number.
examples.zh: 注册时要输入课程号，不能只填「课段编号」。

examples.en: The section number tells you which instructor and room to expect.
examples.zh: 「课段编号」告诉你对应的授课老师和教室。

words.enDefinition: five-digit number identifying one course section in the system

examples.en: Type the exact five-digit CRN into the registration page to enroll.
examples.zh: 在选课页面输入准确的五位「课程号」才能选上课。

examples.en: The lecture and its lab have different CRNs, so register for both.
examples.zh: 大课和实验课的「课程号」不同，两个都要注册。

words.enDefinition: hands-on lab group paired with a lecture course

examples.en: Every lab section for organic chemistry filled within ten minutes.
examples.zh: 有机化学的「实验课段」十分钟内就被抢光了。

examples.en: Your lab section must match the lecture you registered for this fall.
examples.zh: 你的「实验课段」必须与秋季注册的大课配套。

words.enDefinition: small weekly group for reviewing lecture material

examples.en: Attendance in your discussion section counts toward the final grade.
examples.zh: 「讨论课段」的出勤会计入期末总评。

examples.en: TAs lead each discussion section and answer questions before quizzes.
examples.zh: 每个「讨论课段」由助教主持，测验前会答疑。

words.enDefinition: main large-group meeting of a course

examples.en: The morning lecture section filled before my appointment even started.
examples.zh: 还没轮到我的选课时段，上午的「讲授课段」就满了。

examples.en: Choose a lecture section whose pace and professor suit you.
examples.zh: 选一个节奏和老师都合你意的「讲授课段」。

words.enDefinition: small practice session reviewing lecture problems

examples.en: The weekly recitation walks through problem sets before every quiz.
examples.zh: 每周「习题课」会在测验前带大家过一遍习题。

examples.en: Sign up for a recitation time that leaves your Fridays free.
examples.zh: 选一个让你周五完全空闲的「习题课」时段。

words.enDefinition: lab or discussion automatically tied to a lecture

examples.en: The portal enrolls you in the linked section with one click.
examples.zh: 在系统里点一下，就能选上「配套课段」。

examples.en: Each lecture has a linked section for labs on different days.
examples.zh: 每门大课都有不同日子上实验的「配套课段」。

words.enDefinition: course with every single seat taken

examples.en: The economics lecture is a full course, so join the waitlist now.
examples.zh: 经济学大课已是「满员课程」，赶紧加入候补名单。

examples.en: A full course sometimes reopens during the first week when schedules shift.
examples.zh: 开学第一周大家调整课表时，「满员课程」有时会重新放出名额。

collocations: a full course with a waitlist

words.enDefinition: section no longer accepting enrollment

examples.en: The Tuesday lab shows as a closed section in the portal.
examples.zh: 周二的实验课在系统里显示为「已关闭课段」。

examples.en: Closed sections sometimes reopen when departments raise the enrollment caps.
examples.zh: 系里提高选课上限后，「已关闭课段」有时会重新开放。

words.enDefinition: seat still available in a course section

examples.en: Grab the open seat in Friday's lab before someone else does.
examples.zh: 赶在别人前面抢下周五实验课的「空余名额」。

examples.en: Refresh the portal at noon; open seats appear when students drop.
examples.zh: 中午刷新一下系统，有同学退课就会出现「空余名额」。

words.enDefinition: queue for a full course when seats reopen

examples.en: Put yourself on the waitlist the moment a course shows full.
examples.zh: 课程一显示满员，就马上加入「候补名单」。

examples.en: I was seventh on the waitlist and still got in before Friday.
examples.zh: 我当时排在「候补名单」第七位，周五前还是选上了。

words.enDefinition: your spot in line for a full course

examples.en: My waitlist position improved to third after four students dropped.
examples.zh: 四位同学退课后，我的「候补位次」升到了第三。

examples.en: Check your waitlist position daily throughout the first week of class.
examples.zh: 开学第一周，每天都查看一下自己的「候补位次」。

words.enDefinition: message telling you a waitlisted seat opened

examples.en: You have twenty-four hours to respond to a waitlist notification.
examples.zh: 收到「候补通知」后，你有二十四小时可以确认。

examples.en: Turn on email alerts so a waitlist notification never slips past.
examples.zh: 打开邮件提醒，就不会错过任何「候补通知」。

words.enDefinition: maximum number of students allowed in a course

examples.en: The enrollment cap for the seminar is fifteen, so register early.
examples.zh: 这门研讨课的「选课上限」是十五人，要尽早注册。

examples.en: Instructors sometimes raise the enrollment cap when demand is clearly high.
examples.zh: 需求明显很高时，老师有时会提高「选课上限」。

words.enDefinition: same course offered under two department codes

examples.en: The cross-listed course counts toward either the sociology or the policy major.
examples.zh: 这门「跨系并列课程」可以计入社会学或政策学专业。

examples.en: Cross-listed courses appear twice in the catalog with different course codes.
examples.zh: 「跨系并列课程」在目录里会以不同课程代码出现两次。

words.enDefinition: taking courses at a nearby partner university

examples.en: Through cross-registration, I take Japanese at the college across town.
examples.zh: 通过「跨校选课」，我可以在城另一头的学院修日语。

examples.en: Cross-registration paperwork needs signatures from the registrars at both universities.
examples.zh: 「跨校选课」的材料需要两所大学注册办公室的签字。

words.enDefinition: overlap between two courses you want to take

examples.en: The portal rejected my add because of a time conflict with statistics.
examples.zh: 因为和统计课「时间冲突」，系统拒绝了我的加选。

examples.en: Ask about an exception if the time conflict is only fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 如果「时间冲突」只有十五分钟，可以申请豁免。

words.enDefinition: course limited to certain majors or class years

examples.en: That studio is a restricted course open only to design majors.
examples.zh: 那门工作室课是「限制选课」，只对设计专业开放。

examples.en: Restricted courses open to everyone once juniors finish registering first.
examples.zh: 大三学生优先注册结束后，「限制选课」向所有人开放。

words.enDefinition: section taught remotely over video instead of in class

examples.en: The online section freed my Tuesdays for hospital volunteering shifts.
examples.zh: 选了「线上课段」，周二就能腾出来去医院做志愿。

examples.en: Online sections fill just as fast as in-person ones now.
examples.zh: 现在「线上课段」和线下课段一样抢手。

words.enDefinition: block on your account that stops registration

examples.en: A registration hold appeared because I never returned my lab key.
examples.zh: 因为一直没还实验室钥匙，我的账户被「注册冻结」了。

examples.en: Clear every registration hold before your enrollment appointment time arrives.
examples.zh: 选课预约时段到来之前，务必解除所有「注册冻结」。

words.enDefinition: hold lifted only after you meet your advisor

examples.en: The advising hold lifted an hour after my meeting with Professor Chen.
examples.zh: 和陈教授面谈完一小时后，我的「导师面谈限制」就解除了。

examples.en: Every freshman has an advising hold until they discuss course choices.
examples.zh: 每个大一新生都带着「导师面谈限制」，谈完选课才能解除。

words.enDefinition: registration block tied to academic standing issues

examples.en: An academic hold from probation required a meeting with the dean.
examples.zh: 试读期导致的「学业冻结」需要和院长面谈解除。

examples.en: The advisor explained how to appeal the academic hold before registration.
examples.zh: 导师讲解了注册前如何申诉解除「学业冻结」。

words.enDefinition: website where students manage course enrollment

examples.en: The registration portal crashed again during the busiest enrollment hour.
examples.zh: 选课最繁忙的时段，「选课系统」又崩了。

examples.en: Bookmark the registration portal on your phone before your appointment.
examples.zh: 选课时段到来前，把「选课系统」收藏到手机里。

words.enDefinition: official proof that you are currently enrolled

examples.en: Download your enrollment verification for the bank and the visa office.
examples.zh: 下载「在读证明」，银行和签证处都要用。

examples.en: Enrollment verification requests are processed instantly through the student portal.
examples.zh: 「在读证明」的申请在学生门户里可以即时办理。

words.enDefinition: portal tool for finding courses with filters

examples.en: Use the course search filters to find classes after four only.
examples.zh: 用「课程搜索」筛选器，只找四点以后的课。

examples.en: The course search shows live seat counts for every section.
examples.zh: 「课程搜索」会显示每个课段的实时余位。

words.enDefinition: report comparing your credits against graduation requirements

examples.en: Always run a fresh degree audit before each advising appointment.
examples.zh: 每次导师面谈前，务必先跑一遍最新的「学位审核」。

examples.en: My degree audit flagged one missing writing requirement for graduation.
examples.zh: 「学位审核」提示我还缺一项毕业要求的写作课。

words.enDefinition: office managing enrollment, records, and registration

examples.en: Email the registrar about the grading error before Friday's deadline.
examples.zh: 周五截止日前，把评分错误的问题邮件发给「注册办公室」。

examples.en: The registrar extended enrollment for students affected by the system outage.
examples.zh: 系统故障期间，「注册办公室」为受影响的学生延长了选课时间。

words.enDefinition: personal code required before you can register

examples.en: Your advisor gives you a registration PIN after your meeting.
examples.zh: 面谈结束后，导师会给你「注册密码」。

examples.en: I lost my registration PIN and had to visit the registrar's office.
examples.zh: 我弄丢了「注册密码」，只好跑一趟注册办公室。

words.enDefinition: officially canceling all your courses before a term

examples.en: A registration cancellation before classes start avoids late penalties entirely.
examples.zh: 开课前提交「取消注册」可以避免逾期罚款。

examples.en: Her registration cancellation freed two seats in the morning lecture.
examples.zh: 她的「取消注册」让上午的大课空出了两个名额。

words.enDefinition: staff member who guides your course planning

examples.en: My academic advisor caught a missing prerequisite before registration opened.
examples.zh: 选课开放前，「学业导师」发现我缺一门先修课。

examples.en: Meet your academic advisor at least once every semester to stay on track.
examples.zh: 每学期至少和「学业导师」见一次面，确保进度不跑偏。

words.enDefinition: advisor's official consent for your course plan

examples.en: Your registration stays locked until you get advisor approval online.
examples.zh: 在网上拿到「导师批准」之前，你无法完成注册。

examples.en: Advisor approval is required for any credit overload or late add.
examples.zh: 任何超修学分或逾期加选都需要「导师批准」。

words.enDefinition: scheduled meeting with an advisor before registering

examples.en: Book your advising appointment early; slots vanish during registration season.
examples.zh: 「导师面谈预约」要趁早，选课季的时段秒没。

examples.en: Bring a draft schedule to your advising appointment to save time.
examples.zh: 去「导师面谈预约」时带上草拟课表，能省不少时间。

words.enDefinition: weeks set aside for advising before registration

examples.en: During advising period, professors keep extended office hours for questions.
examples.zh: 「选课咨询周」期间，教授会延长答疑时间。

examples.en: The advising period comes right before registration opens every term.
examples.zh: 每学期「选课咨询周」一结束，选课就开放。

words.enDefinition: student enrolled in at least the standard minimum credits

examples.en: Twelve credits is the floor to count as a full-time student.
examples.zh: 十二个学分是「全日制学生」的最低标准。

examples.en: Dropping below full-time student status can affect scholarships and visas.
examples.zh: 低于「全日制学生」标准可能影响奖学金和签证。

words.enDefinition: student taking fewer credits than full-time requires

examples.en: As a part-time student, I spread my degree over five years.
examples.zh: 作为「非全日制学生」，我把学业拉长到了五年。

examples.en: Part-time students usually register after full-timers during the priority rounds.
examples.zh: 优先选课轮次中，「非全日制学生」通常排在全日制学生之后。

words.enDefinition: student enrolled temporarily from another institution

examples.en: As a visiting student, I could only register for open courses.
examples.zh: 作为「访问学生」，我只能选还有余位的课程。

examples.en: Visiting students usually apply through cross-registration to take courses here.
examples.zh: 「访问学生」通常通过跨校选课来这边上课。

words.enDefinition: student taking courses without pursuing a degree

examples.en: Non-degree students register last, after all the degree-seeking student groups.
examples.zh: 「非学位学生」最后注册，排在所有学位生之后。

examples.en: She enrolled as a non-degree student to test the program first.
examples.zh: 她先以「非学位学生」身份选课，试试这个项目。

words.enDefinition: fewest students needed for a course to run

examples.en: The Japanese seminar was canceled because minimum enrollment wasn't reached.
examples.zh: 日语研讨课因为没达到「最低开课人数」被取消了。

examples.en: Courses below minimum enrollment sometimes merge into a single section.
examples.zh: 未达「最低开课人数」的课程有时会合并成一个课段。

words.enDefinition: choosing your modules for the term at UK universities

examples.en: Module selection at Manchester closes two weeks before term starts.
examples.zh: 曼彻斯特大学的「模块选课」在开学前两周截止。

examples.en: Module selection opens online, and popular modules fill within hours.
examples.zh: 「模块选课」在线上开放，热门模块几小时就被抢光。

words.enDefinition: approved list of courses mapped to graduation

examples.en: File an updated plan of study before your junior year registration.
examples.zh: 大三选课之前，先提交更新版的「学业计划」。

examples.en: Your plan of study maps every requirement to a specific term.
examples.zh: 「学业计划」把每项要求落实到具体学期。

words.enDefinition: small discussion course required for new students

examples.en: My first-year seminar capped its enrollment at just twelve students.
examples.zh: 我们的「新生研讨课」选课人数上限只有十二人。

examples.en: First-year seminars usually count toward the writing general education requirement.
examples.zh: 「新生研讨课」通常可计入写作类通识要求。

words.enDefinition: second-choice course ready if your first fills

examples.en: Always list a backup course in case your first choice fills.
examples.zh: 一定要准备「备选课程」，以防首选的课满了。

examples.en: I picked a backup course in case the economics seminar filled before my registration time.
examples.zh: 我选了一门「备选课程」，以防经济学研讨课在我能选课前满员。

collocations: backup course in the same slot

words.enDefinition: choosing which courses to take each term

examples.en: Course selection for sophomores opens Thursday morning at eight sharp.
examples.zh: 大二的「选课」周四早上八点整开放。

examples.en: Careful course selection keeps your workload balanced across the week.
examples.zh: 用心「选课」能让一周的课业负担更均衡。

words.enDefinition: pre-registration step listing the courses you want

examples.en: Submit your course request list before the department plans sections.
examples.zh: 在系里规划课段之前，提交你的「选课意向」清单。

examples.en: Course requests don't guarantee seats, but they do guide scheduling.
examples.zh: 「选课意向申请」不保证名额，但会影响排课。

words.enDefinition: record of every course you have taken so far

examples.en: Your course history helps advisors spot repeated or missing courses.
examples.zh: 「修课记录」能帮导师发现重复或遗漏的课程。

examples.en: Export your course history before meeting with the transfer evaluator.
examples.zh: 见转学分评估老师之前，先导出你的「修课记录」。

words.enDefinition: the specific day your registration opens

examples.en: Mark your enrollment date on the calendar so you're ready at dawn.
examples.zh: 把「选课日期」标在日历上，当天早起待命。

examples.en: Enrollment dates differ by class standing, with seniors going first.
examples.zh: 「选课日期」按年级划分，大四学生最先选。

words.enDefinition: notice confirming the courses you successfully registered for

examples.en: Check your enrollment confirmation carefully; I was dropped from chemistry.
examples.zh: 仔细核对「选课确认」，我的化学课就被系统退掉了。

examples.en: Your enrollment confirmation email lists every CRN you successfully registered.
examples.zh: 「选课确认」邮件会列出你成功注册的所有课程号。

words.enDefinition: paper form for course changes after the online deadline

examples.en: Get the add/drop form signed if the portal won't process your change.
examples.zh: 如果系统处理不了你的改课申请，就找老师签「退补选表格」。

examples.en: The registrar's office still accepts the paper add/drop form after deadlines.
examples.zh: 截止日之后，注册办公室仍接受纸质「退补选表格」。

words.enDefinition: hours when your personal registration is open

examples.en: Your enrollment window opens at seven and stays open all night.
examples.zh: 你的「选课窗口」七点开启，整夜都有效。

examples.en: Once the enrollment window closes, only late adds with permission remain.
examples.zh: 「选课窗口」关闭后，就只剩需要许可的逾期加选了。

words.enDefinition: online tool that generates possible timetables

examples.en: The schedule builder automatically blocks out any sections that overlap.
examples.zh: 「排课工具」会自动剔除有冲突的课段。

examples.en: Save two versions in the schedule builder before your enrollment window opens.
examples.zh: 「选课窗口」开放前，先在排课工具里存好两套方案。

words.enDefinition: university canceling a course, usually for low enrollment

examples.en: Check your email daily during add/drop week for any course cancellation.
examples.zh: 退补选周每天查邮件，留意有没有「课程取消」。

examples.en: A course cancellation forced me into a nine a.m. statistics section.
examples.zh: 一次「课程取消」逼得我选了早上九点的统计课段。

collocations: course cancellation due to low enrollment
